[SWS_PER_00453]
⌈
When
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::RecoverKey
is
called, Persistency shall try to restore the given key to a consistent state, including
redundancy. Depending on available information, the key might be removed, reset
to the initial value as described in [SWS_PER_00477], or might contain an outdated
value after the operation.
⌋

[SWS_PER_00453]
⌈
When
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::RecoverKey
is
called for an existing key-value pair, Persistency shall try to restore the
given key to a consistent state, including redundancy.
Depending on available
information, the key might be removed, reset to the initial value as described
in [SWS_PER_00477], or might contain an outdated value after the operation.
⌋
